profile.profileValueBio: Matheus is a software engineer on the product team, building bids and tender management software, including autonomous bid agents that streamline opportunity discovery, requirement analysis, document preparation, compliance checks, pricing, and submission. He focuses on turning complex tender workflows into reliable, easy-to-use products that help teams work faster and make better bidding decisions.

chat.previewDeploymentPipeline: We're seeing 502 errors after the latest build went out. Rollback didn't help.
chat.previewRefundDoubleCharge: I was billed twice on the 3rd. Can someone look into this and reverse the duplicate?
chat.previewAnalyticsPermissions: I'm getting a 403 since the role update yesterday. Tried clearing cache already.
chat.previewSustainabilityReport: Hi team, I'm looking for the latest ESG disclosure for our upcoming board meeting.
chat.previewBulkExportTimeout: Tried three times this morning. It gets to about 60% then throws a gateway error.
chat.previewInvoiceUnpaid: Our payment cleared on Friday — screenshot of the confirmation attached here.
chat.previewOnboardingDocs: Got a new backend dev starting Monday. Need the standard checklist and repo access steps.
chat.previewDowngradeProPlan: We're winding down the project at end of quarter. Is there an early termination fee?
chat.previewApiRateLimit: Our batch jobs are getting 429s every 15 minutes between 9 and 11 AM. Need a bump.
chat.previewSslCertExpired: Users are seeing certificate warnings when they hit our shop page. This is urgent.
chat.previewAnnualBilling: We're ready to commit for the year. Can you send over the annual pricing sheet?
chat.previewDatePickerBug: Selecting June 5 produces June 4 in the CSV export. Screenshot attached for reference.
chat.previewWebhookFailures: Getting intermittent 500s on the webhook endpoint since roughly 2 AM UTC. Logs linked.
chat.previewGranularRbac: Our engineering leads need read-only on production but full write access on staging.
chat.previewAndroidCrash: Three users reported the same crash on launch. Stack trace from Firebase attached.
chat.previewLatamPartnership: We're expanding into Mexico and Brazil next quarter. Would love to explore a reseller deal.
chat.previewMayLogsExport: Our compliance audit starts next week. I need a full activity log dump for the auditors.
chat.previewWhiteLabelOptions: We have five partners asking about branded dashboards. Do you offer white-label tiers?
chat.previewMfaEnforcement: Our security team wants to know if SMS fallback is still supported after the enforcement date.
chat.previewMissingLineItems: The January invoice export is short by three line items. The PDF version is correct though.
chat.previewProcurementDemo: Need a 30-minute walkthrough of the vendor portal for our finance leads this Friday.
chat.previewAzureSso: We're migrating from Okta to Azure AD. What's the typical setup timeline for SSO?
chat.previewCancellationRequest: Our ops lead resigned last week. Need to transfer ownership to me before we can cancel.
chat.msg101: We're seeing 502s on staging right after the latest build. We rolled back, but the health checks are still red.
chat.msg102: Thanks, Olivia. I'm checking the deploy logs and upstream gateway config now.
chat.msg103: The weird part is API traffic looks fine, but the web container is failing readiness probes.
chat.msg104: Found a mismatch in the staging environment variables. I'm applying the fix and will confirm once the probes recover.
chat.msg105: Great. Keep me posted, this is blocking our QA pass.
chat.msg201: I was charged twice for order #8823. One payment cleared on the 3rd and the duplicate posted this morning.
chat.msg202: Thanks for flagging it, Phoenix. I can see both transactions and I'm checking which one was attached to the invoice.
chat.msg203: Please reverse the duplicate if possible. Our finance team is closing the week today.
chat.msg204: The duplicate was a retry from the old payment method. I've started the refund and sent the receipt to your billing email.
chat.msg205: Perfect, thanks. I'll let finance know to expect it.
chat.msg301: I'm getting a 403 on the analytics dashboard since yesterday's role update. Clearing cache did not change anything.
chat.msg302: Thanks, Lana. I'll compare your new role against the dashboard permission set.
chat.msg303: I still have access to exports, just not the dashboard views. Other admins on my team can open them.
chat.msg304: Looks like the Analytics Viewer permission was dropped from your custom role. I've reattached it for your workspace.
chat.msg305: That fixed it. Thanks for the quick help.
chat.msg501: Hi, we're preparing board materials and need your latest ESG disclosure, especially the carbon footprint section.
chat.msg502: Hi Demi. I can share the 2025 report and the carbon accounting appendix. Do you need the raw emissions data too?
chat.msg503: Yes, raw Scope 3 data would help. Our board packet needs supply-chain numbers, not just the summary.
chat.msg504: Got it. I'll send the executive summary, Scope 3 CSV, and the methodology note in one bundle.
chat.msg505: Perfect. That should cover everything for Thursday.
chat.msg601: The bulk export keeps timing out. It reaches about 60 percent and then throws a gateway error.
chat.msg602: Thanks, Candice. Is this for the full shipment history export or a filtered date range?
chat.msg603: Full history. We need it for a warehouse migration, so the file is pretty large.
chat.msg604: I'll queue it as an async export and email the download link once it finishes. That avoids the gateway timeout.
chat.msg701: Invoice INV-4821 still shows unpaid even though our bank transfer cleared last Friday.
chat.msg702: Thanks, Natali. Can you send the transfer reference so I can match it against our payment processor records?
chat.msg703: Just attached the confirmation screenshot. The reference ends in 9147.
chat.msg704: Found it. The payment was received but not reconciled to the invoice. I've marked INV-4821 as paid.
chat.msg801: We have a backend developer starting Monday. What's the best onboarding path for repo access and environment setup?
chat.msg802: Hi Drew. I'll send the standard engineering checklist and invite link for the developer workspace.
chat.msg803: Great. Please include staging credentials and any branch naming rules if those are documented.
chat.msg804: Will do. I'll add the staging access request and our repository conventions to the same thread.
chat.msg901: We're winding down the current project and need to downgrade from Enterprise to Pro at the end of the quarter.
chat.msg902: Understood, Orlando. I can walk through the downgrade path and confirm whether any contract terms apply.
chat.msg903: Main question is whether there is an early termination fee or if we can switch at renewal.
chat.msg904: Your agreement allows downgrade at renewal with 30 days notice. I'll send the date and feature impact summary.
chat.msg1001: Our batch jobs are hitting 429s every few minutes during peak hours. We need a temporary rate limit bump.
chat.msg1002: Thanks, Andi. Which API keys are affected and what peak window are you seeing?
chat.msg1003: Mostly invoice-sync and customer-import, between 9 and 11 AM Dublin time.
chat.msg1004: I can raise the limit for those keys for seven days while we review your long-term quota.
chat.msg1101: Our custom domain started showing certificate warnings overnight. Users cannot complete checkout.
chat.msg1102: Thanks, Kate. I'm checking the certificate renewal job and DNS validation now.
chat.msg1103: DNS has not changed on our side. The warning says the certificate expired at midnight.
chat.msg1104: The renewal job failed on CAA validation. I've reissued the certificate manually and it's propagating.
chat.msg1201: We're ready to move to annual billing. Is there a discount if we commit for the full year?
chat.msg1202: Hi Alec. Yes, annual billing includes a discount. I can send a quote with the annual terms today.
chat.msg1203: Please include the media team seats and the analytics add-on in the quote.
chat.msg1204: Done. I'll include both and mark the quote for annual prepay so procurement can review it quickly.
chat.msg1301: The report date picker is off by one. Selecting June 5 exports June 4 in the CSV.
chat.msg1302: Thanks, Ariana. Does the UI show the right date before export, or is it wrong there too?
chat.msg1303: The UI looks correct. Only the CSV output is shifted.
chat.msg1304: That points to timezone conversion in the export job. I'll attach your screenshot to the bug ticket.
chat.msg1401: Zapier webhook delivery is failing intermittently with 500s. It started around 2 AM UTC.
chat.msg1402: Thanks, Steven. Can you share one failed delivery ID and the endpoint path?
chat.msg1404: I found retries backing up on that endpoint. We're increasing worker capacity and replaying the failed deliveries.
chat.msg1501: Our team leads need read-only production access but full write permissions in staging. Can RBAC support that split?
chat.msg1502: Yes, Lori. You can separate environment scope from permission level. I'll send the policy example.
chat.msg1503: Great. We also need audit logs to show who changed staging configs.
chat.msg1504: That is included. I'll add the audit log filters to the example so your leads can test it.
chat.msg1601: Our Android users on version 14 are seeing crashes right after the splash screen. Firebase shows three affected devices so far.
chat.msg1602: Thanks for reporting this, Koray. Can you share the Firebase crashlytics link? I'll get the mobile team on it.
chat.msg1603: Sure, linked the stack trace in the ticket. Looks like a null pointer in the payment module init.
chat.msg1604: Found it — there's an edge case when Google Play Services isn't updated. We're pushing a hotfix now.
chat.msg1701: We're expanding into Mexico and Brazil next quarter and want to explore a reseller partnership.
chat.msg1702: Thanks, Josh. That sounds aligned with our LATAM plans. Do you already have target customer segments in mind?
chat.msg1703: Mostly mid-market logistics and retail teams. We can bring initial pipeline if the reseller terms work.
chat.msg1704: I'll introduce you to our partnerships lead and share the reseller tier overview before Friday.
chat.msg1801: Our compliance audit starts next week. We need activity logs for all May workspace events.
chat.msg1802: Hi Mollie. We can export admin activity, login events, and file access logs. Do auditors need CSV or JSON?
chat.msg1803: CSV is fine, but it needs user IDs and timestamps in UTC.
chat.msg1804: Understood. I'll prepare the May export with UTC timestamps and send it through the secure file link.
chat.msg1901: We have five reseller partners asking whether the dashboard can be white-labeled.
chat.msg1902: Hi Rene. White-labeling is available on the partner tier. Are they asking about custom domain, logo, or full theme control?
chat.msg1903: All three, ideally. They want their own domain and branded reports for clients.
chat.msg1904: That is supported. I'll send the partner tier doc and a sample branded report template.
chat.msg2001: Our security team has questions about the MFA enforcement rollout. Is SMS fallback still supported?
chat.msg2002: Hi Rylee. SMS fallback remains available, but we recommend authenticator apps or security keys for admins.
chat.msg2003: Can we enforce security keys for admins and allow SMS only for contractors?
chat.msg2004: Yes. You can configure that by user group. I'll send the policy setup steps.
chat.msg2101: The January invoice CSV is missing three line items. The PDF invoice looks correct.
chat.msg2102: Thanks, Sienna. Are the missing line items discounts, usage charges, or taxes?
chat.msg2103: Two are usage charges and one is a tax adjustment. They all appear in the PDF.
chat.msg2104: I found an export filter excluding adjusted usage lines. We'll patch it and regenerate the January CSV for you.
chat.msg2201: Could we schedule a 30-minute demo for our procurement and finance leads this Friday?
chat.msg2202: Absolutely, Noah. Should the walkthrough focus on vendor onboarding, approvals, or reporting?
chat.msg2203: Vendor onboarding and approval routing are the priority. Reporting can be a quick overview.
chat.msg2204: Great. I'll send a Friday slot with an agenda tailored to those two workflows.
chat.msg2301: We're moving from Okta to Azure AD and need to understand the SSO setup timeline.
chat.msg2302: Hi Eve. Typical Azure AD SSO setup takes one to two business days once metadata is exchanged.
chat.msg2303: We can share metadata today. Will there be downtime during the switch?
chat.msg2304: No downtime if we test with a pilot group first. I'll send the Azure AD checklist and rollout plan.
chat.msg2401: Our ops lead Jamal resigned last week and he was the only account owner. I need ownership transferred to me before we can proceed with anything.
chat.msg2402: Hi Zahir, I can help with that. We'll need verification — can you confirm your role and provide a copy of Jamal's resignation notice?
chat.msg2403: Absolutely. I'm the Operations Director. I've attached his signed notice and HR confirmation.
chat.msg2404: Verified. I've initiated the ownership transfer. It takes about 2 hours to propagate. You'll get a confirmation email once it's done.

mail.bodyMeetingTomorrow:
Hi, let's have a meeting tomorrow to discuss the project. I've been reviewing the project details and have some ideas I'd like to share. It's crucial that we align on our next steps to ensure the project's success.

Please come prepared with any questions or insights you may have. Looking forward to our meeting!

Best regards, William
mail.bodyProjectUpdate:
Thank you for the project update. It looks great! I've gone through the report, and the progress is impressive. The team has done a fantastic job, and I appreciate the hard work everyone has put in.

I have a few minor suggestions that I'll include in the attached document.

Let's discuss these during our next meeting. Keep up the excellent work!

Best regards, Alice
mail.bodyWeekendPlans:
Any plans for the weekend? I was thinking of going hiking in the nearby mountains. It's been a while since we had some outdoor fun.

If you're interested, let me know, and we can plan the details. It'll be a great way to unwind and enjoy nature.

Looking forward to your response!

Best, Bob
mail.bodyQuestionBudget:
I have a question about the budget for the upcoming project. It seems like there's a discrepancy in the allocation of resources.

I've reviewed the budget report and identified a few areas where we might be able to optimize our spending without compromising the project's quality.

I've attached a detailed analysis for your reference. Let's discuss this further in our next meeting.

Thanks, Emily
mail.bodyImportantAnnouncement:
I have an important announcement to make during our team meeting. It pertains to a strategic shift in our approach to the upcoming product launch. We've received valuable feedback from our beta testers, and I believe it's time to make some adjustments to better meet our customers' needs.

This change is crucial to our success, and I look forward to discussing it with the team. Please be prepared to share your insights during the meeting.

Regards, Michael
mail.bodyFeedbackProposal:
Thank you for your feedback on the proposal. It looks great! I'm pleased to hear that you found it promising. The team worked diligently to address all the key points you raised, and I believe we now have a strong foundation for the project.

I've attached the revised proposal for your review.

Please let me know if you have any further comments or suggestions. Looking forward to your response.

Best regards, Sarah
mail.bodyNewProjectIdea:
I have an exciting new project idea to discuss with you. It involves expanding our services to target a niche market that has shown considerable growth in recent months.

I've prepared a detailed proposal outlining the potential benefits and the strategy for execution.

This project has the potential to significantly impact our business positively. Let's set up a meeting to dive into the details and determine if it aligns with our current goals.

Best regards, David
mail.bodyVacationPlans:
Let's plan our vacation for next month. What do you think? I've been thinking of visiting a tropical paradise, and I've put together some destination options.

I believe it's time for us to unwind and recharge. Please take a look at the options and let me know your preferences.

We can start making arrangements to ensure a smooth and enjoyable trip.

Excited to hear your thoughts! Olivia
mail.bodyConferenceRegistration:
I've completed the registration for the conference next month. The event promises to be a great networking opportunity, and I'm looking forward to attending the various sessions and connecting with industry experts.

I've also attached the conference schedule for your reference.

If there are any specific topics or sessions you'd like me to explore, please let me know. It's an exciting event, and I'll make the most of it.

Best regards, James
mail.bodyTeamDinner:
Let's have a team dinner next week to celebrate our success. We've achieved some significant milestones, and it's time to acknowledge our hard work and dedication.

I've made reservations at a lovely restaurant, and I'm sure it'll be an enjoyable evening.

Please confirm your availability and any dietary preferences. Looking forward to a fun and memorable dinner with the team!

Best, Sophia
mail.bodyFeedbackRequest:
I'd like your feedback on the latest project deliverables. We've made significant progress, and I value your input to ensure we're on the right track.

I've attached the deliverables for your review, and I'm particularly interested in any areas where you think we can further enhance the quality or efficiency.

Your feedback is invaluable, and I appreciate your time and expertise. Let's work together to make this project a success.

Regards, Daniel
mail.bodyMeetingAgenda:
Here's the agenda for our meeting next week. I've included all the topics we need to cover, as well as time allocations for each.

If you have any additional items to discuss or any specific points to address, please let me know, and we can integrate them into the agenda.

It's essential that our meeting is productive and addresses all relevant matters.

Looking forward to our meeting! Ava
mail.bodyProductLaunchUpdate:
The product launch is on track. I'll provide an update during our call. We've made substantial progress in the development and marketing of our new product.

I'm excited to share the latest updates with you during our upcoming call. It's crucial that we coordinate our efforts to ensure a successful launch. Please come prepared with any questions or insights you may have.

Let's make this product launch a resounding success!

Best regards, William
mail.bodyTravelItinerary:
I've received the travel itinerary. It looks great! Thank you for your prompt assistance in arranging the details. I've reviewed the schedule and the accommodations, and everything seems to be in order. I'm looking forward to the trip, and I'm confident it'll be a smooth and enjoyable experience.

If there are any specific activities or attractions you recommend at our destination, please feel free to share your suggestions.

Excited for the trip! Mia
mail.bodyTeamBuildingEvent:
Let's plan a team-building event for our department. Team cohesion and morale are vital to our success, and I believe a well-organized team-building event can be incredibly beneficial. I've done some research and have a few ideas for fun and engaging activities.

Please let me know your thoughts and availability. We want this event to be both enjoyable and productive.

Together, we'll strengthen our team and boost our performance.

Regards, Ethan
mail.bodyBudgetApproval:
The budget has been approved. We can proceed with the project. I'm delighted to inform you that our budget proposal has received the green light from the finance department. This is a significant milestone, and it means we can move forward with the project as planned.

I've attached the finalized budget for your reference. Let's ensure that we stay on track and deliver the project on time and within budget.

It's an exciting time for us! Chloe
mail.bodyWeekendHike:
Who's up for a weekend hike in the mountains? I've been craving some outdoor adventure, and a hike in the mountains sounds like the perfect escape. If you're up for the challenge, we can explore some scenic trails and enjoy the beauty of nature.

I've done some research and have a few routes in mind.

Let me know if you're interested, and we can plan the details.

It's sure to be a memorable experience! Samuel

docs.title: What is Workspaacing?
docs.intro1: Workspaacing is a modern, open-source admin dashboard starter template built with Next.js 16, React 19, TypeScript, and shadcn/ui. It provides developers with a production-ready foundation for building responsive admin panels, SaaS dashboards, and internal tools.
docs.intro2: Instead of spending weeks setting up authentication, navigation, layouts, and UI components, Workspaacing gives you a complete, polished dashboard that you can customize and deploy in minutes. Clone the repository, install dependencies, and your dashboard is ready.
docs.whatIsDesc1: Workspaacing is a dashboard starter template designed to accelerate the development of admin interfaces. It combines a carefully crafted UI with a robust technical foundation, giving developers everything they need to build professional dashboards without starting from scratch.
docs.featureDashboardsDesc: Default, CRM, Finance, Analytics, Productivity, E-commerce, Academy, Logistics, Infrastructure, File Manager, and Patient Monitoring.
docs.featureAuthDesc: Two login and register page variants with demo credentials, ready for integration with your own auth provider.
docs.featureThemesDesc: Light, dark, and system mode with multiple preset themes (Default, Brutalist, Soft Pop, Tangerine) and full CSS variable customization.
docs.featureLayoutDesc: Collapsible sidebar, top navbar, and mobile-friendly design that adapts to any screen size.
docs.featureI18nDesc: Built-in internationalization with Portuguese (Brazil) and English, powered by next-intl.
docs.featurePagesDesc: Email, Chat, Calendar, Kanban, Tasks, Invoice, Profile, Users, Roles, and more.
docs.featuresDesc: Workspaacing is designed with developer experience and end-user experience in mind. Here are the key benefits:
docs.benefitProductivityDesc: Pre-built components and layouts eliminate repetitive setup work, letting you focus on building features.
docs.benefitDesignDesc: Built on shadcn/ui and Radix UI primitives, ensuring accessible, polished components throughout.
docs.benefitThemeDesc: Switch between themes instantly with the View Transition API animation. Create custom presets using CSS variables.
docs.benefitTypeDesc: Full TypeScript strict mode with Biome for linting and formatting, catching errors before they reach production.
docs.benefitPerformanceDesc: Server Components by default, lazy loading, and optimized bundle size for fast page loads.
docs.benefitCicdDesc: GitHub Actions workflows for building, linting, testing, and automated releases with zero configuration.
docs.benefitSecurityDesc: Dependabot, CodeQL, Secret Scanning, OpenSSF Scorecard, SBOM generation, and supply chain verification.
docs.techStackDesc: Workspaacing is built with modern, industry-standard technologies:
docs.techNextjs: React framework with App Router and Server Components
docs.techNextThemes: Theme management with dark mode support
docs.techRecharts: Composable charting library for data visualization
docs.techBiome: Fast linter and formatter for JavaScript and TypeScript
docs.dashboardsDesc: Workspaacing ships with 11 pre-built dashboard variants, each designed for a specific use case. All dashboards share the same layout system and can be customized independently.
docs.dashDefault: General-purpose dashboard with key metrics and recent activity
docs.dashCrm: Customer relationship management with sales pipeline and contacts
docs.dashFinance: Financial overview with revenue charts, transactions, and budgets
docs.dashAnalytics: Data analytics with charts, graphs, and performance metrics
docs.dashProductivity: Task management with progress tracking and team overview
docs.dashEcommerce: Online store management with orders, products, and customers
docs.dashAcademy: Learning management with courses, students, and progress
docs.dashLogistics: Supply chain and delivery tracking with route optimization
docs.dashInfrastructure: Server and infrastructure monitoring with health checks
docs.dashFileManager: File browsing, upload, and organization interface
docs.dashPatient: Healthcare dashboard with patient vitals and appointments
docs.pagesDesc: Beyond dashboards, Workspaacing includes ready-to-use pages for common admin workflows:
docs.pageAuth: Login and Register pages in two variants (v1 and v2), with social auth placeholder and demo credentials.
docs.pageEmail: Inbox with message list, read/unread states, and compose interface.
docs.pageChat: Real-time chat interface with conversation list and message threads.
docs.pageCalendar: Event calendar with month, week, and day views.
docs.pageKanban: Drag-and-drop board for project and task management.
docs.pageTasks: Task list with status, priority, and assignment tracking.
docs.pageInvoice: Invoice management with create, view, and export functionality.
docs.pageProfile: User profile with avatar, bio, and activity history.
docs.pageUsers: User management and role-based access control pages.
docs.gettingStartedDesc: Getting started with Workspaacing is straightforward. Follow these steps to have your dashboard running locally:
docs.prereqNode: Required for Next.js and the development server.
docs.installOpen: Open the following link in your browser. You will be redirected to the login page. Use the demo credentials to access the dashboard:
docs.customizationDesc: Workspaacing is designed to be easily customized. Here are the main areas you can modify:
docs.themesDesc: Switch between light and dark mode, or choose from preset themes in Settings > Appearance. Create custom themes by modifying CSS variables in your global stylesheet. Each theme preset is a standalone CSS file that overrides the default color palette.
docs.navigationDesc: Edit src/navigation/sidebar/sidebar-items.ts to add, remove, or reorder sidebar navigation items. Each item supports icons, badges, and nested sub-items.
docs.layoutDesc: Choose between side panel and full-page navigation in Settings > Experience. The sidebar supports collapsible and expanded states with smooth animations.
docs.i18nDesc1: Add new languages by creating message files in the
docs.i18nDesc2: directory and registering them in src/i18n/request.ts. Currently supported: Portuguese (Brazil) and English.
docs.faqFreeAnswer: Yes. Workspaacing is completely free and open source. There are no paid features, subscriptions, or hidden costs.
docs.faqCommercial: Can I use Workspaacing for commercial projects?
docs.faqCommercialAnswer: Absolutely. Workspaacing is designed to be used as a starter template for your own projects. Clone it, customize it, and build your product on top of it.
docs.faqBackendAnswer: No. Workspaacing is a frontend-only template. The demo uses hardcoded credentials and client-side cookies for authentication. Integrate your own backend, auth provider, or database as needed.
docs.faqDeployAnswer: Workspaacing is optimized for Vercel deployment. Push your code to GitHub and Vercel will automatically build and deploy it. You can also deploy to any platform that supports Next.js (Netlify, Railway, Docker, etc.).
docs.faqNewPages: Can I add new dashboard pages?
docs.faqNewPagesAnswer: Yes. Create a new page under src/app/(main)/dashboard/ and add a corresponding entry in the sidebar items configuration. The layout, navigation, and theme system will automatically apply to your new page.
docs.faqBrowsersAnswer: Workspaacing supports all modern browsers including Chrome, Firefox, Safari, and Edge. It uses modern web APIs with appropriate fallbacks for older browsers.

billing.title: How billing works
billing.description: Supabase uses organization-based billing. You choose a plan (Pro, Team, or Enterprise) for your organization, then each project within it runs on its own compute instance. The plan subscription covers platform features and usage quotas. Compute is billed separately per project.
billing.example: Pro and Team plans include $10/month in compute credits, which covers one Micro instance. Additional projects each add their own compute cost. For example, a Pro org with 2 projects on Micro compute costs: $25 (plan) + $10 (project 1) + $10 (project 2) - $10 (credits) = $35/month.

faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.q1: Can I cap my usage so my bill doesn't run over?
faq.a1: Yes. Spend caps are on by default on the Pro Plan. You can turn spend caps off for usage beyond the Plan limits to pay as you grow.
faq.q2: I'm worried I could end up with a huge bill at the end of the month.
faq.a2: Spend caps are on by default and you need to toggle them off from your dashboard to enable pay as you grow pricing.
faq.a3: Our Pro Plan is charged up front, and billed on a monthly basis. Additional usage costs are also billed at the end of the month.
faq.q4: Does Supabase charge sales tax, VAT or GST?
faq.a4: Supabase applies sales tax, VAT, GST, and other indirect taxes where required by law, based on your billing address.
faq.q5: Are you going to change your pricing in the future?
faq.a5: Pricing may change in the future. As a team of developers, we are committed to keeping our pricing as developer friendly as possible.
faq.q6: What happens if I cancel my subscription?
faq.a6: The organization is allocated credits for unused time during the billing month. Those credits can be used for other projects.
faq.q7: How can I track my usage?
faq.a7: You can track your organization's usage at any time on the usage page in the dashboard, which shows how each project is tracking against your plan's limits.
faq.q8: What if I need one project for development and one for production?
faq.a8: You can create two projects, one for development and one for production — the Free Plan includes two free projects. You can also use Branching, available on the Pro Plan and above.
faq.q9: Can I self-host Supabase for free?
faq.a9: Yes, you can use the Docker setup or the Supabase CLI. Supabase Studio is also available in the Docker setup.
faq.q10: Can I pause a free project?
faq.a10: Yes, you can pause a project at any time. Our Free Plan gives you 2 free projects, but you can have as many paused projects as you want.
